name: Yatsuo (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Yatsuo town emblem in orange: a broken ring open at the top with two hooked ends.
history: Flag of the former town of Yatsuo in Toyama Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-04-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 14 August 1954.

features.role: Yatsuo town emblem — a broken ring open at the top with two hooked ends
